exceptions.scope: bounded current source evidence and same-backbone generator
exceptions.reason: All 13 rated complete source questions are easy. Increasing dimensions, adding operations or introducing fractions to manufacture harder bands would exceed the extracted backbones. No evidence supports moderate/hard; reopen on new source evidence.

policy: Seed, choice order, profile identity and irrelevant scalar-query coordinates do not create mathematical novelty. Eligible sum pairs are unordered; subtraction pairs are ordered. Declared finite domain scale 1..3 is a conservative workload policy, not a mathematical impossibility claim.
